lesson.title: Tourism and the future: reading
lesson.title_ar: السياحة والمستقبل (1): قراءة مقال اكتشاف اليمن واستخراج المترادفات والأضداد والحقائق

lines: Look at the article below. What sort of magazine do you think it is from? Look at the headline and pictures. How does it seem connected with the last lesson?
Read the article and do activity 6.11 A in the Workbook.
DISCOVERING YEMEN   (By Jim [surname blurred in official PDF bitmap])
Photo caption: A majestic view of the mountains as we travelled north-west from Sana'a.

We left Sana'a early and travelled up into the magnificent mountains to the north-west of the capital. During the long trip, I became friends with Faysal Hatem Al Qadhi, the driver of the four-wheel-drive. I found out to my surprise that he was the owner of the little travel company that was taking us on this trip. As we talked, I started seeing him as the face of the future of Yemen. A typical Yemeni, Faysal is friendly, polite and kind, and full of energy and ambition for the future.

What Faysal told me about his business showed this clearly. Having always been interested in tourism, he started his company fifteen months ago with just one old four-wheel-drive. Now he has two new vehicles and the company is growing fast.

His ambition is to have eight or ten 4WDs two years from now and to take visitors all over Yemen. Looking a few years into the future, Faysal hopes he will have a wife and children. He doesn't want to be very rich, but he does hope to own a house and to give his family the things they need.

Does he think tourism will change Yemen? Yes, but he believes most of the changes will be good ones. For example, there will be better roads and hotels, and people will have more money. However, he doesn't feel that people will start to think about money and nothing else. He is certain that the traditional way of life is strong enough to prevent that.
Re-read the article and complete activities 6.11B, and C and D in the Workbook.

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي وفحص بصري (PB p. 49):
1) سطر اسم الكاتب تحت عنوان DISCOVERING YEMEN مضمّن داخل صورة نقطية بدقة منخفضة جداً في ملف PDF الرسمي (160 × 158 px / 50 ppi)، حيث تظهر كلمتا By Jim بوضوح بينما اللقب مطموس كلياً؛ والتزاماً بالقاعدة 7 لم نُخمّن اللقب وسُجّل للتحقق من النسخة الورقية في REVIEW_NEEDED.md.
2) حُفظت الصيغة المطبوعة في سطر التوجيه السفلي حرفياً: complete activities 6.11B, and C and D in the Workbook..

interactive_spot.label: التمييز بين الصحيح والخطأ وما لا يصرّح به النص (6.11 B–C)

simple_explain.html:
• الفرق بين الخطأ (Wrong) وما قد يصح أو لا يصح (?):
    • الجملتان 1 (الاتجاه north بدل north-west) و7 (الادعاء أنه قلق من تدمير التقاليد عكس يقينه بقوتها) خاطئتان صراحةً وتُصحَّحان في 6.11 C.
    • الجملتان 3 (لم يصرّح النص بحبه للسفر ذاته بل باهتمامه الدائم بالسياحة) و6 (لم يذكر ملايين السياح مطلقاً) غير محسومتين من النص فتأخذان ?.
  • معاني الأضداد والمترادفات في 6.11 D:
    past ≠ future · rude ≠ polite · worse ≠ better · modern ≠ traditional
    journey = trip · discovered = found out · caring = kind · stop = prevent.

example.html: Heading-to-paragraph match (6.11 A): Para 1 = Getting to know a young Yemeni; Para 2 = Faysal's successful new business; Para 3 = Faysal's hopes for the future; Para 4 = Tourism in the future Yemen.

activities.prompt_literal: 6.11 A Read the article 'Discovering Yemen' and number the paragraph headings in the correct order.
activities.prompt_ar: رقّم عناوين الفقرات الأربع (1–4) بحسب ترتيب ورودها في مقال PB ص 49 (WB ص 78):

items.prompt: ______ Getting to know a young Yemeni

hints: 1: التعرّف على فيصل، 2: بداية شركته قبل 15 شهراً، 3: طموحه للسيارات والأسرة والمنزل، 4: أثر السياحة على اليمن مستقبلاً.

activities.prompt_literal: 6.11 B Tick the correct statements. Write ? after statements that may or may not be true. C Correct the statements that are wrong.
activities.prompt_ar: تقييم العبارات السبع بين الصحيح (✓) وغير الحاسم (?) والخاطئ (✗) مع تصحيح الخطأ في 6.11 C (WB ص 79):

items.question: 1 The visitors drove north from the capital.
items.model_answer: Wrong (✗). Correction (6.11 C): The visitors drove north-west from the capital (Sana'a).
items.explain_ar: المقال يذكر north-west مرتين (في التعليق أسفل الصورة والفقرة الأولى).

items.question: 2 The photo-journalist sees the future of Yemen in Faysal.
items.model_answer: True (✓) — 'I started seeing him as the face of the future of Yemen.'

items.question: 3 Faysal started his business because he loves travelling.
items.model_answer: ? (May or may not be true) — The text says he has 'always been interested in tourism', not whether he personally loves travelling.
items.explain_ar: الاهتمام بالسياحة لا يجزم بذكر السبب المحدد المذكور في العبارة.

items.question: 4 He wants to get married before too long.
items.model_answer: True (✓) — 'Looking a few years into the future, Faysal hopes he will have a wife and children.'
items.explain_ar: يأمل الزواج وتكوين أسرة خلال سنوات قليلة قادمة.

items.question: 5 He wants enough money for his family to live in comfort.
items.model_answer: True (✓) — 'He doesn't want to be very rich, but he does hope to own a house and to give his family the things they need.'
items.explain_ar: يريد منزلاً وتوفير احتياجات أسرته دون ثراء فاحش.

items.question: 6 He thinks it will be bad for Yemen if millions of tourists come.
items.model_answer: ? (May or may not be true) — The article never mentions millions of tourists (only tourism changes in general).
items.explain_ar: عدد 'ملايين السياح' غير مذكور في النص لإثباته أو نفيه.

items.question: 7 He is worried that tourism will destroy the traditional way of life.
items.model_answer: Wrong (✗). Correction (6.11 C): He is NOT worried; he is certain that the traditional way of life is strong enough to prevent people from thinking only about money.
items.explain_ar: تتعارض العبارة صراحةً مع آخر جملة في المقال.

hints: العبارتان الخطأ الواجب تصحيحهما في 6.11 C هما 1 و7 فقط.

activities.prompt_literal: 6.11 D Find antonyms and synonyms in the article for these words.
activities.prompt_ar: استخرج الأضداد والمترادفات الثمانية من مقال PB ص 49 (WB ص 79):
hints: مجموعة الأضداد: future, polite, better, traditional · مجموعة المترادفات: trip, found out, kind, prevent.

questions.stem: In WB 6.11 B–C, why is statement 7 ('He is worried that tourism will destroy the traditional way of life') FALSE?

options.text: Because Faysal is certain that the traditional way of life is strong enough to prevent people from thinking only about money.
Because Faysal does not believe tourism will bring any changes at all.
options.why_wrong: بل أجاب عن سؤال التغيير بنعم: Yes, but he believes most of the changes will be good ones.

options.text: Because Faysal hates tourists and plans to close his travel company.
options.why_wrong: طموحه أن يوسّع شركته من سيارتين إلى ثماني أو عشر سيارات دفع رباعي.

options.text: Because he only wants millions of tourists in Sana'a.
options.why_wrong: لم يذكر ملايين السياح، ويريد أخذ الزوار إلى مختلف أنحاء اليمن.

hints: انظر الجملة الأخيرة من الفقرة الرابعة في PB ص 49.
questions.explain: فيصل مطمئن إلى أن نمط الحياة التقليدي قوي بما يكفي لمنع طغيان التفكير بالمال.

questions.stem: Which pair correctly matches a synonym and an antonym found in PB page 49 (WB 6.11 D)?

options.why_wrong: مرادف journey هو trip، وضد rude هو polite.
مرادف discovered هو found out، وضد worse هو better.
مرادف caring هو kind، وضد past هو future.

hints: stop يساوي prevent؛ وmodern عكسها traditional.
questions.explain: المرادف لـ stop في نهاية المقال هو prevent، والضد لـ modern في السطر ذاته هو traditional.
